note: The Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada's response (January 2020): the CNI is compulsory from 16 and issued to every Burundian of 16 or more; the Isôko information portal gives its fee as 500 Burundian francs. The card's term and the time aren't stated.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Burundi: Requirements and procedure to obtain or replace a national identity card (2016-January 2020), on ecoi.net
sources.said: According to the Isôko information portal, the fee for a CNI is 500 Burundian francs [approximately C$0.35] (Burundi n.d.a). ... the CNI is issued to all Burundians who are at least 16 years old, upon presentation of the required documents
